title: Protocol error inside the initial key exchange answered with UNIMPLEMENTED, KEX continues
quote: During initial KEX, terminate the connection if any unexpected or out-of-sequence packet is received. (strict KEX only)
rationale: NEWKEYS before KEX30, or a duplicate KEX30, answered with UNIMPLEMENTED and the connection kept (v1 D7: OpenSSH, Dropbear, non-strict only). Written by proto-sm stream A (v2) from v1 class D7 (report.md); vocabulary: teammate mapper (UNIMPLEMENTED, SERVICE_ACCEPT, CLOSED/NO_CONN, UA_PW_OK). An accepting word is a behaviour witness, not necessarily a bug.
